budget_items.topic: Transfer from Capital Plan Line to Sewer Connection Fees
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Andrew asked to move the full Capital Plan Line amount because emergencies left no other line available, to pay Leominster connection charges that the budget set at only $10,000.
budget_items.quote: he is asking to take the full amount of $45,500 to transfer to the sewer connection fees line.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Each connection to Leominster costs $3,500; 15 connections this year mean $24,000 owed to Leominster, on top of $7,000 already paid.
budget_items.quote: he needs to pay leominster $24,000, in addition to the $7,000 he already paid.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Fitchburg's connection charge is lower than Leominster's, but most connections are made to Leominster.
budget_items.quote: connection charge is $2,000 but most connections are made to leominster.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Each property pays a $3,500 connection fee that covers the costs, and the difference is expected to balance out next year.
budget_items.quote: they pay the connection fee of $3,500, which covers the costs

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A customer's bank check for connection fees replaced a bounced first payment, and the Building Commissioner had halted work until fees were collected.
budget_items.quote: the customer brought in a bank check for their connection fees to cover the first one that bounced.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Scott said the driving range is for sale for over $1 million, outside the sewer district.
budget_items.quote: the driving range is for sale for over $1 million and andrew noted it was not in the sewer district.
